preserve: All22 relevant P1/P2/P3 scoped groups incl4PL C-alpha and separately named Q; no old experiment rerun; no polytomous/CTT/DIF/MFRM estimator changes.
scope: New numerical diagnostics for native Python mirt binary outcomes. Local core.rasch sigma-free is distinct and remains unchanged. Rasch/fixed-a1PL vs common-free-a1PL identification must follow actual fit structure, not model label.
moments: First-order and distinct pair Bernoulli moments. Xi is full model covariance up tofourth-order union moments. Full physical Jacobian follows actual free/equality-constrained parameters; latent N(0,1) fixed. GLS orthogonal M2, effective rank/df, explicit independence model, R-mirt RMSEA/CFI/TLI conventions verified before production.
references: Installed Python mirt1.2.0 API/source preflight; actualR mirt1.48 fixed-parameter M2 and native probability/Jacobian checks, same linear61[-6,6] grid for numerical matching only; independent GH61/121 and finite differences1e-5/5e-6. R is supporting evidence not unqualified truth. No R calibrations/timeouts for alreadyvalidated point estimates.
MAP_candidates: Classical projected M2 chi-square is a diagnostic comparator only until confirmation.
Unchanged projected M2 statistic with full joint score/moment constrained-Gaussian MAP reference.
Same projected M2 with nonlinear moment re-evaluation at constrained Gaussian MAP perturbations (fixed fitted projection); approximation is explicitly not a full-refit bootstrap.
Separately named covariance-standardized full limited-moment residual Q using the same joint reference, retaining prior drift/curvature, means, nuisance dependence and nullspace.
method_rules: No estimator/prior/bound/default changes. Select independently per3PL/4PL after bounded pilot and before fresh confirmation. All approximations require independent finite-sample evidence, never assume MAP chi-square/Wilks.

alternatives.nonmonotone: Only item1: c1+(d1-c1)expit(a1(theta-b1)-.25(theta-b1)^2); no post-pilot effect strengthening.
alternatives.local_dependence: Only item1 component logit +=1.0*(X2-p2(theta)), item2 generatedfirst. Lambda is not the observed Bernoulli logOR.
alternatives.second_factor: Independent Z~N(0,1), component logits of items1..3 +=.7Z; remaining items unchanged. No posterior choice of affected items/effect.

design.claims: Three prospectively separate global-misfit sensitivity classes/model. Report every class; a successfulclass never certifiesfailedclasses. No per-item causal attribution/FWER/FDR/global uniform validity.

pilot.policy: One native fit per new dataset, share checkpoints acrosscandidate diagnostics. Evaluate math validity, refusal, size and minimum class power; select before confirmation; no pilot certificates.

gates.size: Eachmodel global null one-sided CP upper alpha=.05/2 <=.07; no pooling independentmodels. Lower95% CP alpha=.025 >=.03 to excludeuninformative conservatism.
gates.precision: Dataset-level Bernoulli MCSE<=.004/model; R6000 has MCSE .00281 at p.05 and .00329 at p.07. Exact CP design power/pass-probability calculated before confirmation.
gates.power: Each predeclared class CP lower alpha=.025/(2models*3classes) >.10, R600/class; prospective separate claims only. No easier replacement.
gates.refusal: Native nonconvergence/nonfinite/rank/numerical/constraint failure retained: null=reject, power=nondetection. <=.01 refusal in each null/class; native convergence>=.99.
gates.rank: Scale-normalized Jacobian singular values; effective rank at relative1e-10, audit1e-9/1e-11; unstable rank blocks ordinary inference. Xi positive definite/condition<=1e10, no pseudoinverse artificial uncertainty. Q covariance eigenvalue/mean/nullspace checks; KKT<=1e-7.
gates.reference: Fixed-point R_mirt M2/SRMSR/RMSEA/CFI/TLI relative<=1e-6 or absolute1e-7; Jacobian FD relative<=1e-5+absolute1e-7, union covariance absolute1e-10; algorithmic mismatch unresolved=>NOTCOMPARABLE, no tolerance relaxation.
gates.runtime: Targetactual post-fit P95<1s; numericalvalidity overrides speed.

LRT: Only compatible same-cohort, same-grid, fixed latent scale ML interior identifiable nested fixed/common-a1PL vs2PL may use regular asymptoticchi-square. MAP, 2PL→3PL and3PL→4PL boundaries: no ordinary Wilks p. Raw negative likelihood differences not silently clipped. Pairs require actual parameter restrictions, data and objective checks.
RMSEA: M2-based RMSEA/CFI/TLI descriptive for MAP unless specifically inferentially calibrated; never substitute Q for M2 in those formulas. RMSEA noncentralchiCI withheld for uncertifiedMAP; conventional max(...,0) explicit. Independencebaseline denominator/rank failure refused, not imputed.
futility: No interim acceptance; technical/deadline stop only or finalimpossibility bounds. Do not stop merely becauseinterim upper>finalgate. Pilot may stop infeasible/no meaningfulpower mechanisms. Final incomplete=>NOTCERTIFIED.
archive: Perattempt seed/datahash/coefficients/counts/status/pvalues/rank/bounds/versions/timing, checkpoints and sourceSHAs. Preserve allfailedpreflights. FinalCI archival-only plus lightweight regression; no refitting missing evidence.
